Partial years: Jan–Sep 2025 34,538.14 t (PA 2/2025); Jan–Jul 2025 24,733.42 t (PA 2/2026 same-period column). 2024 yield 26.90 t/ha corresponds to 1,656.92 ha (without P21L), while PA 1/2026 Appendix 2 prints 27.14 t/ha for 2024.

summary: Jan–Aug 2026 yield 15.32 t/ha, 10% below Jan–Aug 2025 (16.98 t/ha); the agronomist expects many black bunches to cut the gap below 10% by year-end (Agro 2/2026).
Jan–Jul 2026 FFB 22,653.78 t (12.85 t/ha), 3% above budget (21,965 t) but 10% below Jan–Jul 2025 (PA 2/2026).
Cost of production RM237.01/t for Jan–Jul 2026, 17% under budget RM286.71/t; all three cost groups under budget.
Biggest block drops Jan–Aug: P12H −26%, P11E −18%, P20K −16%; P21L +25% and P00A +14% (Agro 2/2026).

Watch-outs: rat damage still above 10% in most blocks after May baiting (second round advised), poor pruning in P03C1/P03C3, overnight bunches in P03C1, Curvularia in the nursery, and Mg low in 16 of 27 leaf samples.

issues.title: General charges per ha conflict
issues.detail: PA 2/2026 Table 5 and 5.1 give general charges RM935.65/ha (Jan–Jul 2026), but concluding remark 14.4 says RM828.06/ha. Remark 14.5 says upkeep RM1,168.48/ha vs Table 6 RM1,168.39/ha.

issues.title: Barn owl table rows shifted
issues.detail: PA 2/2026 Table 14 field labels do not match Agro 1/2026 Table 12: e.g. PA "P11E" 5 boxes/80% = Agro P12M; PA "P12H" 25 boxes/88% = Agro P11E; PA "P15D" 6 boxes/67% = Agro P19J. PA total says 161 installed and 98% occupancy (142/161 = 88%) while text says 145 boxes. Dashboard block rows use Agro.

issues.title: 2024 and 2023 yield differ between reports
issues.detail: 2024: Agro 1/2026 Table 13 and PA 2/2025 give 26.90 t/ha (44,576.08 t, about 1,656.92 ha); PA 1/2026 Appendix 2 gives 27.14 t/ha. 2023: Agro 1/2025 Table 24 20.68 t/ha (32,917.61 t) vs PA 1/2026 Appendix 2 21.50 t/ha. Dashboard history uses the Agro values. Agro 1/2025 Table 24 2024 total 44,576.70 t vs PA 2/2025 44,576.08 t.

issues.title: 2025 manuring appendix remarks
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 Appendix 4: October 2025 Mix A 57.85 t and Mix B 230.50 t show delivered and applied equal to required, but the remark column says 0%; the sub-total and total say 100%.

issues.title: Manuring table total
issues.detail: PA 2/2026 Table 10 required column sums to 2,188.80 t vs printed total 2,188.60 t (0.20 t). Applied 1,254.90 t sums correctly; 57% = 1,254.90/2,188.60.

issues.title: Spraying done above to-date budget
issues.detail: PA 2/2026 Table 7: P03C circle 481.20 ha done vs 276.00 ha budget to date but remark "2nd round in progress"; Table 8 P00B selective 326.60 ha done vs 163.30 budget to date. Circle total done 3,002.92 vs budget 3,248.64 (92%); selective 2,958.58 vs 3,361.34 (88%).

issues.title: Area basis for P21G and P12H
issues.detail: PA 2/2026 counts P21G (KG. AUR) 23.00 ha as mature (1,762.32 ha mature) and its 64.50 t in the estate total; PA 1/2026 showed it as immature with 1,739.32 ha mature; Agro calls it P23G. Agro uses P12H 162.30 ha (incl. 12.10 ha tapping right) in census/yield tables vs PA 150.20 ha. The 23 ha is "managed by Ladang Kampung Aur" — possible double count with the Kampung Aur dashboard.

issues.title: Typos and wrong field codes
issues.detail: PA 2/2026: "7,327.80 mt of FFB" should be EFB; total FFB printed "2,2653.78"; supplying in "P20L" (no such field; P21L?); thinning in "P12D" (also Agro; no P12D field); pruning rows "P003C1/2/3" and text "P03B". Agro 1/2026 rat census P21L baiting month "June-26" (should be 2025); text 5.3.9 cites "2-2026 Agronomic Report" (should be 2-2025). PA 1/2026 Appendix 1 total 1,799.92 ha omits buildings and unplantable land.

issues.title: SPH differences
issues.detail: P20K SPH 134 (PA 2/2026 Table 1, Agro text) vs 135 (PA Table 21, Agro 1/2026 Table 4); P11E 144 (PA) vs 143 (Agro census Nov-18).

issues.title: Trap checks
issues.detail: "2025 12 months" in PA 2/2026 (48,775.00 t, 28.04 t/ha) is a real Jan–Dec actual (matches PA 1/2026), not budget. "Same period" Jan–Jul 2025 24,733.42 t is an actual. PA 2/2025 "last year 12 months" 44,576.08 t is the 2024 actual. Jan–Sep 2025 34,538.14 t kept out of full years. No Jan–Nov totals.

issues.title: Rat damage: PA vs Agronomy
issues.detail: PA 2/2026 (visit 26 Aug, data to Jul) says the latest fresh rat damage is below 10%; Agro 2/2026 Table 14 post-baiting census Jun 2026 shows 6.38–21.60% (P11E 21.60, P16F 20.40, P20K 20.05, P21L 18.00, P15D 17.70, P19J 16.80, P12M 10.00, P12H 6.38) and says most blocks remain above the 10% threshold.

issues.title: 2027 programme lists a replant block
issues.detail: Agro 2/2026 section 8.1 says no manuring for blocks scheduled for replanting in 2027, and P00A replanting is agreed for 2027 (PA 2/2026), yet Appendix 1(a) gives P00A A1–A4 (157.3 ha) NK3 2.00 kg Jan and May and Mix B 2.00 kg Sep. NK3 is also not defined in the nutrient specifications (only Mix A, Mix B, NK1, Kieserite, RP).

issues.title: Manuring rounds differ (Agro 2/2026 vs PA 2/2026)
issues.detail: Agro Table 7 1st half 2026 Mix B 827.65 t, all 100% applied; PA Table 10 Jan–Jun Mix B rows sum to 827.85 t with May 116.65 t applied (99%) and Jun RP 248.25 of 311.20 t (80%). Agro Table 8 2nd half to Aug: Mix B programme 240.2 t (Aug 82.05 t), no NK2; PA lists Jul NK2 73.35 t + Mix B 252.80 t and Aug Mix B 132.25 t.

issues.title: Palm census table (Agro 2/2026 Table 3)
issues.detail: P12H prints 162.3 ha, 21,349 palms and SPH 142, but 21,349 / 162.3 = 131.5 (142 matches 150.20 ha). P00A SPH 122 (May 2026) vs PA 2/2026 SPH 140. Some palm totals and SPH changed while the census date stayed old (P12H Dec-18, P15D Oct-18, P03C Aug-23).

issues.title: Barn owl total (Agro 2/2026 Table 15)
issues.detail: Units by block add to 161 but the total prints 145; occupied this month 142 → 98% only on 145 (142/161 = 88%). Same pattern as PA 2/2026 Table 14.

issues.title: Harvest interval range and small conflicts (Agro 2/2026)
issues.detail: Text says 9–25 days in 2026, but Table 10 prints P03C Mar "4-13" and P19J Jan "4-19". P12H area 162.30 ha in Tables 1–3 but 150.20 ha in Tables 11 and 16. P19J listed as satisfactorily pruned (5.3.2) yet significantly over-pruned (6.2). Ripeness check P00A1 in text, photos captioned P00A4. Thinning 75 palms in "P12D" + 152 in P19J by Aug (PA: 167 by Jul); "P20L" (6.4) is not a block. Desilting 73.35 chains (Agro) vs 73.50 (PA).

actions.item: Follow up supplier to deliver the remaining 870 t of 2026 fertiliser and apply before the monsoon
Clear tall-palm normal pruning backlog in P00A, P00B and P03C (about 104 ha)
Expedite deboling of Ganoderma palms; mound infected palms under 20 years old
Consider a rat-baiting campaign in sub-blocks with prolonged fresh and old damage; consult agronomist and Regional Office
Second round of baiting where damage is still 10% or more: group sub-blocks, 100% baiting in one direction, post-baiting census after a month, replace baits every 7 days until uptake below 20%
Plant beneficial plants mix 60% Cassia cobanensis, 20% Antigonon leptopus, 20% Turnera subulata
Continue infilling P19J, P20K and P21L towards 148 SPH (230 palms supplied in 2026 to Aug)
Remove wild seedlings, sterile and runt palms; continue thinning
Spot-spray sodium chlorate on tough woodies, ferns and wild seedlings (incl. on trunks)
Keep circle spraying within 2 m radius; avoid stripe spraying on harvest paths (greatly reduced in P16F2, Agro 2/2026)
Use one-sided nozzle or baffle cover on mist blowers; inspect sprayed areas after 2 weeks and touch up
Eradicate giant VOPs in P15D4, P15D5, P19J and P20K (JCB plus chemical poisoning, follow-up checks); remove seed-producing weeds before they seed
Complete drain desilting in flood-prone areas before the monsoon (about Oct)
Laterite soggy, slippery low-lying and inclined road stretches
Strictly apply minimum ripeness of 1 detached fresh loose fruit before harvesting
Keep harvest interval about 15 days; overripe improved to 3–8% but overnight bunches still found (now P03C1) — closer supervision and same-day evacuation
Improve pruning in P03C1 and P03C3 (excess dry hanging fronds) and P11E4; avoid over-pruning in P19J
Restack fronds and circle-rake after floods in P19J
Mound leaning young-mature palms with sand or soil bags
Extend mechanised in-field collection (Timac) to P19J, P20K and P21L
Spread EFB evenly, no high heaps (P15D2); prioritise marginal lateritic and Bungor soils (Kosfarm mill about 8 km, RM8/t)
Spread fertiliser evenly with no lumps (P03C1); for palms 7+ years apply at the frond-heap edge within the weeded circle
Investigate the wet floor in the fertiliser store (leaks, rain through vents)
Keep regular patrols on settlement boundaries; evacuate FFB and loose fruit the same day
Nursery: follow the Curvularia fungicide rotation with Annex Combi (systemic) in week 1; cull abnormal seedlings before transplanting and field planting
Check vehicle running-hour records and servicing
Replant P00A in 2027
Palm census of P19J, P20K and P21L
Rat baiting after Oct 2025 census (done Nov–Dec 2025)
Complete the 2025 fertiliser programme
Split P20K and P21L into two sub-blocks each for leaf sampling
Carry out the palm census in P00B, P03C, P12H, P15D and P16F (PARAS drone unit suggested)
Correct magnesium: supplementary kieserite (16 of 27 leaf samples moderately low or low, Mar 2026)
Give delayed fertiliser to young-mature and prime palms first when application resumes
Collect and reuse fertiliser spilled on the store floor
Nursery: improve watering so water reaches the bottom of large polybags; consider drip irrigation or black weed mats
Nursery: protect the irrigation ponds (no-spray buffer, fencing, fish as indicator) and keep the two ponds as separate sources
Nursery: buy trays with detachable cells; install a showering station to water seedlings on lorries before dispatch
Stay vigilant on Ganoderma (symptoms more apparent, e.g. P03C1)
Continue annual desilting of drains (73.35 chains done to Aug 2026)
Close the 2026 yield gap with 2025 to below 10% by year-end

LADANG DAWN - FACT PACK (Far East Holdings Berhad, Far East group). Estate Manager En. Muhamad Uzairi Bin Abdul Rahim; Deputy COO / Plantation Controller En. Nazaruddin Bin Hasim. Central group nursery 25.50 ha.

SOURCES. (1) PA Report 2/2026, visit 26 August 2026, period January to July 2026, Planting Advisor Tn. Hj. Mohd Sufian Bin Yusoff, checked against the July progress report. (2) PA Report 1/2026, visit 11 February 2026, period January to December 2025. (3) Agronomy Report 2/2026, visit 18 September 2026, Senior Agronomist Mr. Lai Hong Heng, data to August 2026, with the 2027 fertiliser programme. (4) Agronomy Report 1/2026, visit 25 February 2026; previous agronomy visit 27 October 2025 (Agro 2/2025), which first printed the 2026 programme. Earlier: PA 2/2025 (28 Oct 2025, May-Sep 2025), Agro 1/2025 (26 Mar 2025).

AREA (PA 2/2026 Table 1, Jul 2026). Total 1,841.01 ha; oil palm 1,762.32 ha (incl. P21G 23.00 ha managed by Ladang Kampung Aur): P00A 157.30 (SPH 140, Chemara, 2000), P00B 163.30 (139, 2000), P03C 276.00 (133, 2003), P11E 258.94 (144, Felda, 2011), P12H 150.20 (142, 2012), P12M 61.32 (148, 2012), P15D 245.80 (143, 2015), P16F 203.06 (145, 2016), P19J 61.00 (138, 2019), P20K 80.00 (134, 2020), P21L 82.40 (135, Chemara, 2021), P21G 23.00 (120). Buildings 7.80, nursery 25.50, unplantable 33.29, tapping right 12.10 ha. 65% young mature and prime, 34% old mature over 20 years. Terrain flat to undulating. 42.45% Bungor series soil. 118.29 ha flood-prone (P11E, P12M, P16F, P19J). P00A to be replanted in 2027.

CROP. Jan-Jul 2026 (PA 2/2026 Table 20): FFB 22,653.78 t = 12.85 t/ha vs budget 21,965.00 t (12.46 t/ha), 3% above; same period 2025 24,733.42 t (14.22 t/ha), 10% lower. Annual budget 41,500 t (23.55 t/ha). CPO 4,487.12 t, OER 19.81% (budget 18.95%), kernel 1,088.93 t, KER 4.81%. By field Jan-Jul 2026 t/ha: P00A 14.21, P00B 14.81, P03C 14.25, P11E 13.72, P12H 12.38, P12M 10.83, P15D 12.53, P16F 12.87, P19J 10.81, P20K 7.82, P21L 11.53, P21G 2.80; 5.63 bunches/palm, ABW 16.55 kg. Expected to meet the year budget; good bunch load toward year-end. 2025 (PA 1/2026): 48,775.00 t, 28.04 t/ha on 1,739.32 ha, 28% above budget 38,000 t and 3% above 2024; SPH 138, 12.26 bunches/palm, ABW 16.58 kg; CPO 9,310.33 t, OER 19.09%.

YIELD HISTORY (t/ha). Agro 1/2026: 2021 21.16, 2022 24.30, 2023 20.68, 2024 26.90, 2025 28.04. PA 1/2026 Appendix 2: 2020 20.15, 2023 21.50, 2024 27.14. 2025 by field: P00A 25.58, P00B 30.35, P03C 30.73, P11E 31.60, P12H 31.91, P12M 23.98, P15D 27.52, P16F 28.55, P19J 22.68, P20K 20.08 (+55%), P21L 15.96 (+234%). Tonnes: 2023 32,917.61; 2024 44,576.08; 2025 48,775.00. Crop recovery 99% (2024), 100% (2025).

COST (PA 2/2026 Table 23, Jan-Jul 2026, RM per t FFB). General charges 72.79 (budget 87.73), upkeep & cultivation 90.89 (112.76), harvesting & collection 73.33 (86.23: harvesting 51.45, internal transport 21.88); total ex-estate 237.01 vs 286.71, 17% under. Per ha: general charges 935.65 vs 1,093.41 (14% under); upkeep 1,168.39 vs 1,405.41. Upkeep RM/ha actual vs budget: weeding 111.64/141.98, manuring 873.78/894.55, pests 24.02/106.95, census 4.43/8.81, drains 2.77/35.35, roads 73.91/117.25, boundary 0.56/15.94, supplying 3.32/1.19, pruning 73.97/83.39. GC overspends: visiting & HQ (+17%, field day for UMB, Prosper, Tehdara), paid leave (+34%), medical (+75%), labour quarters (+7%), recruitment (+87%), workmen compensation (+111%), MSPO (+28%). 2025 (PA 1/2026): ex-estate RM208.76/t vs budget RM276.31 (GC 61.88, upkeep 74.91, H&C 71.97); grand total incl. mill, windfall tax and amortisation RM369.41/t.

LABOUR (Jul 2026). 164 workers vs requirement 156 (1 per 12 ha): harvesters 98 vs 86 (surplus 12, training), drivers/loaders 14 vs 13, weeding 7 vs 8, manuring 8 vs 5, mandor 4 vs 9, nursery 22 vs 25, general 11 vs 10. In 7 months: 33 recruited, 22 returned, 1 transferred in; 16 sent home, 26 on long leave, 9 absconded, 6 transferred out. Contractors: Ayden Smart, Endri Maju, Usaha Kaffah (harvesting and transport), Ku Chin Hock and Navin (transport). New Assistant Manager Muhammad Nabhan Dini and Executive Mohamad Afiq from 1 Jul 2026.

HARVESTING. Interval 15 days, 14 rounds in 7 months; no ripe bunches left; enforce minimum 1 detached fresh loose fruit. Productivity 2.41 t/man-day, average RM36.89/t, earnings RM88.81/day (P16F 3.07 t/day; P21L RM139.31/day). Mechanisation: 6 crawlers on 317.40 ha (10.35 t/machine-day, 2.05 t/harvester-day), 5 Timacs on 837.73 ha (14.15, 2.58); extend to P19J, P20K, P21L. Agro (Feb 2026): over-ripe P11E3 12%, P16F3 10%, P03C5 10%, P03C3 8%, P20K 6%; overnight bunches P03C5; old bunches in circles P19J.

MANURING. 2026 to Jul: required 2,188.60 t, delivered 1,319.05 t, applied 1,254.90 t = 57%; Jun RP 80%; Jul-Oct rounds (NK2, Mix B) awaiting delivery, about 870 t. 2026 programme (Agro 1/2026, g/palm): old palms P00A (A4 only; A1-A3 replant 2027) and P00B NK2 2,000 and Mix B 2,000; P03C NK2 2,000 Jan and Jul, Mix B 2,000 Apr and Oct; P11E, P12H, P15D, P16F Mix B 2,500 and 2,000 four rounds plus RP 1,750-2,000 Jun (kieserite 750 g in E4 and D2-D4); P12M Mix B 2,000 x4 + RP 2,000; young P19J, P20K, P21L Mix B 1,500-2,000 x4, kieserite 500 g Mar, RP 2,000 Jun. EFB 2026: 7,327.80 t on 122.13 ha (incl. mill 2,451.78 t in P03C); 2025 14,804.56 t on 246.74 ha. 2025 programme 2,384.60 t completed with delays up to 3 months. Application quality improved, still slight lumping; store floor wet.

LEAF ANALYSIS (Agro 2/2026; 27 samples sent 4 Mar 2026, results 18 Apr 2026; no P00A or P00B samples). Most nutrients adequate or high; N and B mainly high; K, Ca, P normal. Mg the main concern: 16 of 27 moderately low or low (lowest P15D4 0.21%, P15D3 0.22%; highest P03C1 0.33%, P21L and P12M 0.32%) - correct with supplementary kieserite. N 2.41-2.87%, K 1.04-1.28%, B 11.52-17.95 ppm (lowest in P03C). Earlier (Apr 2025, Agro 1/2026): generally balanced, some moderately low Mg.

WEEDING. To Jul 2026: circle 3,002.92 ha vs 3,248.64 budget to date; selective 2,958.58 vs 3,361.34; slightly behind; circles clean; soft grasses preserved with 2 m glyphosate radius. Sprayers 5.50 ha/day circle (RM82.50/day), 4.50 ha/day selective (RM72.00/day). Agro: soft grass cover thinner; untidy P12H3, P19J, P15D4, P00B3 (Clidemia, Tetracera, Stenochlaena, Dicranopteris, VOPs).

PESTS AND DISEASES. Rat baiting 1 round over 1,154.82 ha (P11E-P21L); latest fresh damage below 10%; campaign suggested for persistent sub-blocks. Oct 2025 census 15-20% in young and prime fields; after Nov-Dec 2025 baiting Jan 2026 8-10%. 145 barn owl boxes, 98% occupied. No bagworm. Ganoderma below 5% in most fields; above 5% in P00A2/P00A3 (26 years, replant 2027); 2025 census P00A 1.8%, P00B 1%, P03C 1.6%; deboling in progress.

PRUNING. Progressive pruning 1,338.72 ha 100%; normal pruning in tall palms 319.25 of 423.60 ha (75%): P00A2/3/4 57%, P00B 73%, P03C1-3 76%; 104 ha balance. Agro: dry hanging fronds in P00B3, P03C3, P00A4, P11E4, P12M; roadside over-pruning reduced.

FIELD WORKS. Census by GPS done. 167 palms thinned (P12D, P19J); 230 palms supplied in P19J, P20K, P21L; SPH 135-138 vs 148 planted in young fields. Drains: desilting 73.50 of 1,979 chains (3.71%), finish before monsoon. Roads: grading 7,343 chains; lateriting 0 of 280 chains. Boundary in good condition, patrols needed near Bandar Melati settlement.

NURSERY. Phase 7: 184,367 seeds (2025), 174,112 transplanted, 39,377 sold, 124,104 in main nursery, RM8.86 per seedling. Phase 8: 129,318 seeds (Jan-Jul 2026), 63,132 transplanted, 60,091 in pre-nursery, RM5.65 per seedling. Agro: Curvularia on seedlings, change fungicide rotation (systemic).

CAPEX AND VEHICLES. No capex budgeted for 2026; bearer plant RM1,972,638.75 recorded. Vehicles below budget except Toyota Hilux CFD 6769 (bought Aug 2025).

RAINFALL (mm, days). 2021 1,663.5/115; 2022 2,104.0/137; 2023 2,004.0/96; 2024 2,087.4/91; 2025 1,951.6/127; Jan-Jul 2026 958.0/69. Average about 1,975 mm over 115 days; heaviest Nov-Jan.

2025 REVIEW (PA 1/2026, Jan-Dec 2025). 163 workers vs 161 required (harvesting/pruning 90 vs 86); 57 recruited, 41 Indonesian workers. General charges RM1,735.21/ha vs RM1,826.05 budget (labour and amenities over because of the February 2025 minimum-wage rise and ORP rules for leave and sick pay). Upkeep RM2,100.56/ha vs RM2,541.98 (pest control savings). Harvesting RM71.97/t vs RM76.37; 24 rounds in 2025 at 15-day intervals. Mechanisation 2025: 8 crawlers over 647 ha (11.35 t/machine-day, 2.64 t/harvester-day), 5 Timacs over 794 ha (16.14, 2.98). Drains: 1,450 chains desilted. Roads: 7,895 chains graded; no lateriting done. Pruning backlog 99 ha in tall palms at Dec 2025. 2 rounds of rat baiting in palms under 20 years. EFB 14,805 t in P00B, P03C, P11E and P15D. Capex 2025 RM2,288,015.62 incl. unbudgeted Toyota Hilux CFD 6769 RM146,332.86 and bearer plant RM1,972,638.75. Nursery Phase 6: 210,030 seeds, 122,257 seedlings sold, 49,471 still in the main nursery being collected by Ladang Bukit Jin and Ladang Sungai Gayung, RM12.45 per seedling.

AGRONOMIST VIEW (Agro 1/2026). Favourable age profile (53% of area 8-19 years), average 140 SPH. Yields rose after the 2023 dip, with the young fields P19J, P20K and P21L in their steep growth phase. Remaining issues from the previous visit: over-ripe bunches, tall-palm pruning delays and rat damage. Prioritise manuring of young-mature and prime palms over palms 20 years and older if delays occur. EFB is cheap to haul from Kosfarm mill (about 8 km, RM8/t) - prioritise lateritic and Bungor soils, avoid thick heaps. No manuring for blocks scheduled for replanting. Programme to be reviewed at the next visit.


AGRONOMY REPORT 2/2026 (visit 18 Sep 2026, data to Aug 2026). Yield Jan-Aug 2026 15.32 t/ha vs Jan-Aug 2025 16.98 (-10%), Table 16 by block (t/ha 2026 vs 2025): P00A 16.62 vs 14.64 (+14%), P00B 17.12 vs 17.98 (-5%), P03C 16.67 vs 18.08 (-8%), P11E 15.79 vs 19.15 (-18%), P12H 14.52 vs 19.73 (-26%), P12M 12.64 vs 13.71 (-8%), P15D 15.25 vs 17.13 (-11%), P16F 15.81 vs 16.97 (-7%), P19J 13.54 vs 14.72 (-8%), P20K 10.69 vs 12.70 (-16%), P21L 14.75 vs 11.81 (+25%), P21G6 3.51. Many black bunches; aim to cut the gap below 10% by year-end. No tonnage printed for Jan-Aug. Area: Agro now 1,774.42 ha (P12H 162.30 incl. 12 ha tapping right). Census Aug 2025-May 2026: 239,617 palms, average SPH 137 (P00A 122, May 2026); census still pending in P00B, P03C, P12H, P15D, P16F. Supply 2026 to Aug: P19J 92, P20K 48, P21L 90 palms. Thinning to Aug: 75 runts in P12D and 152 in P19J. Manuring: 1st half 2026 complete (Mix B 827.65 t, kieserite 36.25, NK2 143.75, RP 311.2; 1,318.85 t, 100%); 2nd half to Aug Mix B programme 240.2 t, delivered 223.5, applied 132.8 (55%). Lumpy fertiliser in P03C1; good demo in P15D1; spillage in store. EFB to Aug: 8,402.1 t on 140.04 of 440 ha (32%): P00A 1,498.08 t/24.97 ha, P03C 5,541.42/92.36, P11E 229.9/3.83, P15D 1,132.7/18.88; high heaps in P15D2. Harvesting interval 9-25 days in 2026 (10-20 in 2025); overripe 3-8% (P12H4 8%, P00A1 4%, P15D1 3%) vs 6-12% in Feb; overnight bunches in P03C1; crop losses low. Pruning to Aug: progressive 67% of the year's programme; normal pruning in tall palms 359.84 ha (81%): P00A2-A4 58%, P00B 89%, P03C1-C3 85%; P03C1 and P03C3 unsatisfactory, P11E4 dry fronds, P19J over-pruned; roadside over-pruning greatly reduced. Weeding to Aug: selective 3,607.04 of 3,630.04 ha programmed (rounds 1-2 100%, round 3 5%); circle 3,463.32 of 3,630.04 ha (round 1 100%, round 2 97%). Ground cover improved, soft grasses denser; giant VOPs in P15D4, P15D5, P19J, P20K; incomplete weed kill P11E5, P15D5.
